div.p: An optional element used to describe the history, specifically the chronology, or a sequential order of changes undergone by the function being described.

functionHistory is used to provide information on the precise chronology of the performance of the function being described. Examples include how and why the function was performed, who played what roles in the performance of the function, and how the function changed over time.

Use the repeatable p element to structure longer texts in several paragraphs. If required and suitable, use formattingExtension to make use of more detailed formatting options such as lists, tables, or section headers in XHTML.
Where functionDescription describes a narrative description of the function’s purpose, functionHistory focuses on chronology and the changes over time.
